//: Development harness of template-dashboard, not part of the template. It installs the two template packages under src-app/mfe_packages as workspaces and runs their type check and tests in one place. The packages pin their dependencies to exact published versions, which is what a product's copy installs. The overrides keep the harness on the React version the packages pin, so the tests run what a product's copy installs. "reselect": "5.2.0" dedupes reselect for the widget bundle build's shared-unit version check (it fails when two versions of a shared package are reachable from the shared closure): recharts pins reselect exactly at 5.2.0 while @reduxjs/toolkit and @base-ui/utils accept that version, so one copy satisfies every dependent - template-shell/package.json carries the same override for the same reason.
name: frontx-template-dashboard-dev-harness
